SELECT au.id, au.username, au.phone, au.email, au.password_hash AS passwordHash, au.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, au.role_id AS roleId, au.status, au.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, au.created_at AS createdAt, au.updated_at AS updatedAt, au.is_deleted AS isDeleted, sr.code AS roleCode, sr.name AS roleName FROM admin_user au LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON au.role_id = sr.id AND sr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE au.is_deleted = 0
AND (au.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR au.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND au.role_id = #{roleId} AND au.status = #{status} ORDER BY au.created_at DESC
